title: Spec Review
description: analysis/spec-reviews/[story-id].spec-review.json. Produced by the Spec Reviewer Agent, an advisory AI review at Gate 3: it never approves or rejects, and from schema_version 2.0 it has no field that could (CLAUDE.md §3.5). Combines a checklist-driven findings list with deterministic risk-coverage. A 2.x review names the Gate 3 input digest it reviewed (input_digest, printed by the runner's step instruction) and its round (1 to 3); the runner uses it only while that digest is current and the round is the one it expects (docs/review-gates.md, "Advisory AI review"). 1.x reviews, which carried an auto_approval_eligible hint, stay valid as history.

input_digest.description: 2.x: the Gate 3 (specs_reviewed) input digest this review was made against, as the runner's step instruction printed it. The runner uses the review only while it is the gate's current digest.

round.description: 2.x: which review of this gate in the run this is. After round 1, only what changed since the previous round is reviewed; there is no round 4.

findings.description: Checklist issues the human should weigh at Gate 3. Empty array = the deterministic checks found nothing; it does NOT mean approved.

type.description: The checklist category this finding belongs to.

tc_id.description: Optional. The TC-XXX (or API-XXX) this finding concerns.

risk_id.description: Optional. The RISK-XXX this finding concerns.

severity.description: How strongly this should weigh on the Gate 3 decision.

quote.description: Optional. The spec text the finding is about, quoted.

recommendations.description: Free-text suggestions for the human / Planner (e.g. 'add a negative case for TC-003').

risk_coverage.description: One entry per RISK-XXX in context.json.risks[]. Deterministic from the RISK -> TC chain — no LLM.

covering_test_case_ids.description: TCs whose risk_ids include this risk. May be empty.

uncovered_high_severity_count.description: Count of uncovered_risks whose severity is 'high'. In a 1.x review, when > 0, auto_approval_eligible must be false (enforced above).

auto_approval_eligible.description: 1.x only, kept so older reviews stay valid: a hint the human never had to follow. A 2.x review must not carry it: an advisory review has no field that could approve (CLAUDE.md §3.5).
